name: wedding-invitation
description: Customisable Arabic wedding invitation website (React + Vite) with an admin dashboard, guestbook and background music.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
